[color=#ffff00][head=3]Mechanical Interactions[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]Mechanical Interactions are things that are possible due to the nature of a sandbox game. These rules are subject to change and we're always looking for ways to implement them into the codebase instead of them needing to be rules.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.1[/color] End-of-round-griefing (EORG) is not allowed under any circumstance. Do not engage in disruptive behavior, including fighting. EOR safe time starts with the end of round announcement, when there are 12 minutes left in the shift. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.2[/color] Venmar Station, Medical Dispatch and 512m around both are categorized as Safe Zones. While in a Safe Zone, you must not use any explosives, destructive devices, or fire your ship guns. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
- [color=#a4885c]M.2A[/color] During the first 6 hours of a shift, Auric Outpost is categorized as a Safe Zone.
- [color=#a4885c]M.2B[/color] Within Safe Zones, antagonistic actions such as murders, attacks, and thefts are to be handled IC. Major damage such as bombings or station destruction will be handled by an Admin. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.3[/color] Do not do anything to a Point of Interest that will stop it from working as it’s intended to. ★
[color=#a4885c]M.4[/color] If you've participated in a raid upon LPB or Sevastopol, please wait a minimum of 3 shifts before you complete the content again. This is to give other players a chance to experience the content. After 6 hours into the shift, this embargo is lifted. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.5[/color] Saved ships are to be no larger than 80×50 tiles. ★
[color=#a4885c]M.6[/color] Do not abuse the ship save mechanic to avoid in-character consequences. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.7[/color] Ship backups are only to be used in the event of bugs, server issues, or other OOC problems. Loading backups may only be done with admin permission. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.8[/color] Thrusters should be in a position where it is possible to hit them with ship weapons. There should be no entities (except for at most 2 grilles) that block the path of thrusters being shot from another ship. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
- [color=#a4885c]M8.A[/color] Thrusters should not be placed at the exhaust tile of another thruster.
[color=#a4885c]M.9[/color] Creation of any system that causes server lag is not allowed. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.10[/color] Directional fans should be utilised at airlocks or to create cargo bays, or other fashions you would find in a ship from a Shipyard. They are not to be used as replacements for ship structural design (walls, windows, and all variations thereof). [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]M.11[/color] Do not circumvent gameplay loops or encounters by utilising metaknowledge to modify them. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
- [color=#a4885c]M.11A[/color] Do not build walls, windows or other entities to bypass encounters.
- [color=#a4885c]M.11B[/color] The TDF is to wait for alerts to dead drops before checking locations for them.
[color=#a4885c]M.12[/color] Do not utilise Expeditions as a means of escaping from the consequences of antagonistic activity. Criminals/Antagonists are expected to be find-able within the sector. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
